integrity: The analytic proof gives the all-finite-N real-parameter result; the standalone finite-state program supplies independent exact-rational diagnostics rather than an infinite certificate.
limitations: The comparison is of first two singleton-count atoms at initial full coupon coverage; it is not a general stochastic order, is not claimed for higher siblings, and has not received independent mathematical or historical-priority validation.
title: A pairwise-square law for the first two singleton probabilities at coupon completion
